title: Section Reader View
description: The content frontend module shall display AsciiDoc section content fetched from the backend.
rationale: Students need to read course material in the browser without accessing raw backend storage.

title: Homework Submission View
description: The content frontend module shall allow students to upload homework files and view submission status.
rationale: Students must be able to submit work digitally and confirm their submission was received.

title: Grades View
description: The content frontend module shall display per-homework and course-level grade summaries.
rationale: Students need visibility into their academic performance including late penalties and badge effects.

title: Badges View
description: The content frontend module shall display all available badges and the student's earned badges.
rationale: Badge visibility motivates students by showing achievable milestones and their rewards.

title: Notifications Panel
description: The content frontend module shall display a live notification panel in the navigation bar.
rationale: Students must be informed of system events such as generation failures and admin escalations without refreshing.

title: Section Export Downloads
description: The content frontend module shall trigger browser downloads for PDF and HTML section exports.
rationale: Students need offline access to course material in portable document formats.

title: Section Feedback Modal
description: The content frontend module shall allow students to submit text feedback on any section.
rationale: Student feedback enables the AI professor to detect dissatisfaction and trigger content regeneration.

title: Loading and Error States
description: The content frontend module shall show loading indicators and error messages for all async operations.
rationale: Users must always know whether data is loading or an error occurred to prevent confusion and repeated clicks.

title: Section Navigation
description: The content frontend module shall provide previous and next section navigation controls.
rationale: Students must be able to move sequentially through course sections without returning to the course hub.

title: Fetch Section Content on Mount
description: The content frontend module shall fetch the requested section content automatically on view mount.
rationale: Content must load automatically when the student navigates to a section without requiring manual action.

title: Render Section Title
description: The content frontend module shall display the title field from the section response.
rationale: The section title orients the student within the course structure.

title: Render Section Index
description: The content frontend module shall display the section_index field from the section response.
rationale: The section index tells the student their position in the course sequence.

title: Render AsciiDoc Content as Preformatted Text
description: The content frontend module shall display the content_adoc field inside a preformatted text block.
rationale: AsciiDoc source must be readable without rendering artifacts when no renderer is present.

title: Render Citation Verified Status
description: The content frontend module shall display the citation_verified boolean from the section response.
rationale: Students should know whether the content has passed citation review before relying on it academically.

title: Render Section Version
description: The content frontend module shall display the version field from the section response.
rationale: Showing the version number helps students identify whether they are reading regenerated content.

title: Handle Section 404 Error State
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message when the section fetch returns 404.
rationale: Students must see a clear message when a section does not exist rather than a blank or broken view.

title: Handle Section Pending Review State
description: The content frontend module shall display a pending message when the section fetch returns 202.
rationale: Students must know the section is still under citation review so they do not assume failure.

title: Section Fetch Loading State
description: The content frontend module shall display a loading indicator while the section fetch is in flight.
rationale: A visible loading state prevents the student from thinking the page is broken during network delay.

title: Display Homework Title and Due Date
description: The content frontend module shall display the homework title and due date on the submission view.
rationale: Students need to confirm they are submitting to the correct assignment and check their deadline.

title: File Picker with Accepted Format Restriction
description: The content frontend module shall restrict the file picker to .tex, .md, .markdown, .adoc, and .asciidoc extensions.
rationale: Restricting the picker to accepted extensions reduces invalid uploads before the request is sent.

title: Client-Side Format Validation Before Upload
description: The content frontend module shall reject files with unsupported extensions without making an API request.
rationale: Early rejection saves bandwidth and gives the student instant feedback on file type errors.

title: Client-Side Size Validation Before Upload
description: The content frontend module shall reject files larger than 10 MB without making an API request.
rationale: Early rejection saves bandwidth and gives the student instant feedback on oversized files.

title: Submission Upload Request
description: The content frontend module shall upload the selected file as a homework submission when the student confirms.
rationale: The backend upload endpoint requires multipart form data with the field named file.

title: Upload Progress Indicator
description: The content frontend module shall display upload progress while the submission request is in flight.
rationale: Large files can take several seconds to upload; progress feedback prevents the student from cancelling prematurely.

title: Submission Success State
description: The content frontend module shall display the text Submission received. and latest submission details on HTTP 201.
rationale: Explicit confirmation and the returned submission record assure the student their work was accepted.

title: Fetch and Display Latest Submission
description: The content frontend module shall fetch and display the student's latest submission automatically on view mount.
rationale: Students must see any prior submission when they return to the submission view without re-uploading.

title: Latest Submission Detail Display
description: The content frontend module shall display format, file_size_bytes, submitted_at, and grading_status from the latest submission response.
rationale: These fields tell the student what was submitted, when, and whether grading is complete.

title: No Prior Submission State
description: The content frontend module shall display no prior submission message when the latest submission fetch returns 404.
rationale: Students who have not yet submitted need a clear indication rather than an empty or broken view.

title: Fetch Course Grade Summary
description: The content frontend module shall retrieve the course grade summary automatically on grades view mount.
rationale: The course-level weighted grade must load automatically when the student opens the grades view.

title: Display Weighted Score and Total Weight
description: The content frontend module shall display weighted_score and total_weight from the course grade response.
rationale: Students need the overall course score and the weight denominator to understand how their grade was computed.

title: Derive and Display Letter Grade
description: The content frontend module shall derive and display a letter grade from the student's weighted score.
rationale: Letter grades translate numeric scores into a familiar academic scale understood by students and institutions.

title: Display Score as Percentage
description: The content frontend module shall display the weighted_score formatted as a percentage.
rationale: Percentage format is the conventional representation students expect alongside a letter grade.

title: Fetch Per-Homework Grade
description: The content frontend module shall retrieve the grade for each homework item in the course.
rationale: Per-homework grade details show the student exactly how each assignment contributed to the overall grade.

title: Display Per-Homework Grade Fields
description: The content frontend module shall display raw_score, late_penalty_amount, final_score, badge_waiver_applied, and graded_at for each homework grade.
rationale: These fields give students a complete audit trail of how their final homework score was derived.

title: No Grades Empty State
description: The content frontend module shall display No grades yet. when the course has no graded homework.
rationale: An explicit empty state prevents students from thinking the grades view is broken before any grading occurs.

title: Fetch All Available Badges
description: The content frontend module shall retrieve the list of available badges automatically on badges view mount.
rationale: All badge definitions must be loaded so unearned badges can be shown greyed out alongside earned ones.

title: Fetch Earned Badges
description: The content frontend module shall retrieve the student's earned badges automatically on badges view mount.
rationale: The student's earned badges must be fetched separately to cross-reference against all available badges.

title: Display Badge Definition Fields
description: The content frontend module shall display name, description, milestone, reward, and reward_value for every badge.
rationale: Students need the full badge definition to understand what they must do and what they will receive.

title: Display Earned Badge Details
description: The content frontend module shall display awarded_at and redeemed status for each earned badge.
rationale: Students must know when they earned a badge and whether its reward has already been consumed.

title: Display Unearned Badges Greyed Out
description: The content frontend module shall render unearned badges visually distinct with the milestone requirement shown.
rationale: Showing locked badges with their requirements motivates students toward specific academic milestones.

title: Poll Notifications on Mount and Every 30 Seconds
description: The content frontend module shall retrieve the student's notifications on mount and every 30 seconds.
rationale: Regular polling ensures students see new system events within 30 seconds without requiring a page refresh.

title: Unread Count Badge on Bell Icon
description: The content frontend module shall show the unread notification count on the bell icon and hide it when zero.
rationale: A visible count badge draws attention to pending notifications without requiring the panel to be open.

title: Bell Click Expands Notification Dropdown
description: The content frontend module shall expand a notification dropdown listing all fetched notifications when the bell icon is clicked.
rationale: The dropdown gives students access to notification content without navigating away from their current view.

title: Display Notification Fields
description: The content frontend module shall display type, message, and created_at for each notification in the dropdown.
rationale: Students need the notification type, content, and timestamp to understand what happened and when.

title: Mark Individual Notification Read
description: The content frontend module shall mark the notification as read when a notification is clicked.
rationale: Individual mark-read keeps the unread count accurate as students process each notification.

title: Mark All Notifications Read
description: The content frontend module shall mark each unread notification as read when mark all read is activated.
rationale: Bulk dismissal lets students clear all notifications at once without clicking each one individually.

title: Notifications Empty State
description: The content frontend module shall display No new notifications. when no unread notifications exist.
rationale: An explicit empty state prevents students from thinking the notification panel is broken or loading.

title: Download PDF Export via Authenticated Fetch
description: The content frontend module shall download the PDF section export using an authenticated request.
rationale: The export endpoint requires the Authorization header; bare anchor navigation omits it and returns 401.

title: Download HTML Export via Authenticated Fetch
description: The content frontend module shall download the HTML section export using an authenticated request.
rationale: The export endpoint requires the Authorization header; bare anchor navigation omits it and returns 401.

title: Export Error State
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message when an export request returns a non-200 response.
rationale: Students must know the download failed rather than silently receiving no file.

title: Feedback Button Opens Modal
description: The content frontend module shall open a modal with a textarea when the submit feedback button is clicked.
rationale: A modal keeps feedback submission in context without navigating the student away from the section.

title: Feedback Submission Request
description: The content frontend module shall submit the student's feedback text for the current section.
rationale: The backend feedback endpoint requires the JSON field feedback_text, not text.

title: Feedback Success Closes Modal
description: The content frontend module shall close the feedback modal when the feedback submission succeeds.
rationale: Closing the modal on success removes the input form and signals to the student that submission completed.

title: Feedback Error Shown Inline in Modal
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message inside the feedback modal without closing it on non-201 responses.
rationale: Keeping the modal open with the error preserves the student's feedback text so they can retry.

title: Feedback Text Maximum Length Validation
description: The content frontend module shall prevent submission and show an error when feedback_text exceeds 2000 characters.
rationale: The backend rejects feedback exceeding 2000 characters; client-side validation gives instant feedback.

title: Feedback Text Required Validation
description: The content frontend module shall prevent submission and show an error when feedback_text is empty.
rationale: The backend rejects empty feedback_text; client-side validation prevents a wasted network round-trip.

title: Section Content Loading Indicator
description: The content frontend module shall render a loading indicator while any section content fetch is pending.
rationale: Students must see that content is loading so they do not navigate away before the section renders.

title: Submission Upload Error State
description: The content frontend module shall display Submission failed. Please try again. on unhandled upload errors.
rationale: A generic fallback error message prevents students from seeing unhandled empty states on unexpected failures.

title: Grade Fetch Error State
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message when a grade fetch returns a non-200 response.
rationale: Students must be told grades could not be loaded rather than seeing a blank grades view.

title: Badge Fetch Error State
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message when a badge list fetch returns a non-200 response.
rationale: Students must be informed that badges could not be loaded rather than seeing an empty badge view.

title: Previous Section Navigation Button
description: The content frontend module shall display a previous section button that navigates to sectionIndex minus one.
rationale: Sequential backward navigation lets students review earlier material without returning to the course hub.

title: Next Section Navigation Button
description: The content frontend module shall display a next section button that navigates to sectionIndex plus one.
rationale: Sequential forward navigation lets students progress through the course without returning to the course hub.

title: Disable Previous Button at First Section
description: The content frontend module shall disable the previous button when section_index equals zero.
rationale: Section index zero is the first section; navigating to index minus one would request an invalid section.

title: Section Fetch Request Shape
description: The content frontend module shall send GET /api/v1/courses/{id}/content/{sectionIndex} with the Authorization header.
rationale: The backend requires an authenticated request; omitting the header returns 401 and no content.

title: Section Response Field Binding - id
description: The content frontend module shall bind the id string field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The section id is required for subsequent feedback and export requests scoped to the correct record.

title: Section Response Field Binding - course_id
description: The content frontend module shall bind the course_id string field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The course_id is needed to construct export and feedback URLs for the correct course.

title: Section Response Field Binding - section_index
description: The content frontend module shall bind the section_index integer field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The section_index drives navigation button targets and export URL construction.

title: Section Response Field Binding - content_adoc
description: The content frontend module shall bind the content_adoc string field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The content_adoc value is the raw AsciiDoc the view must render in the preformatted block.

title: Section Response Field Binding - version
description: The content frontend module shall bind the version integer field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The version number must be stored in state so it can be displayed in the section header.

title: Section Response Field Binding - citation_verified
description: The content frontend module shall bind the citation_verified boolean field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The citation_verified flag drives a status indicator that informs students of content review status.

title: Section Response Field Binding - created_at
description: The content frontend module shall bind the created_at ISO 8601 string field from the section JSON response to component state.
rationale: The creation timestamp provides students with the date the section content was generated.

title: Section 404 Error Message Text
description: The content frontend module shall display the text Section not found when the section fetch returns HTTP 404.
rationale: A specific message tells the student the section does not exist rather than suggesting a network problem.

title: Section 202 Pending Review Message Text
description: The content frontend module shall display a pending review message when the section fetch returns HTTP 202.
rationale: This message matches the backend message field and correctly sets the student's expectation.

title: Section Fetch 500 Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display a generic error message when the section fetch returns HTTP 500.
rationale: An internal server error must surface to the student as an actionable message rather than silence.

title: Accepted File Extensions in Picker
description: The content frontend module shall set the file input accept attribute to .tex,.md,.markdown,.adoc,.asciidoc.
rationale: These five extensions are the exact set accepted by DetectFormat in the submission backend.

title: Client-Side Format Error Message Text
description: The content frontend module shall display an unsupported file type error listing the accepted extensions.
rationale: Naming the accepted extensions exactly tells the student what to use without requiring backend consultation.

title: Client-Side Size Limit Value
description: The content frontend module shall reject files whose size exceeds 10485760 bytes before making an upload request.
rationale: 10485760 bytes is the defaultMaxUploadBytes constant in the submission backend handler.

title: Client-Side Size Error Message Text
description: The content frontend module shall display File too large. Maximum size is 10 MB. on client-side size rejection.
rationale: The size limit in human-readable form lets the student immediately understand the constraint.

title: Upload Multipart Field Name
description: The content frontend module shall include the file in the multipart body under the form field name file.
rationale: The backend calls r.FormFile("file"); any other field name results in HTTP 400.

title: Upload HTTP 413 Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display File too large. Maximum size is 10 MB. when the upload returns HTTP 413.
rationale: 413 means the server also enforces the size limit; the same user-friendly message applies.

title: Upload HTTP 422 Unsupported Format Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display an unsupported format error when the upload returns HTTP 422 UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.
rationale: The backend returns 422 with UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT when DetectFormat fails; the UI must surface this clearly.

title: Upload HTTP 422 Invalid Content Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display a content mismatch error when the upload returns HTTP 422 INVALID_CONTENT.
rationale: The backend validates content against the format heuristics; the student must be told the file content was rejected.

title: Upload HTTP 409 Already Submitted Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display You have already submitted for this homework. when the upload returns HTTP 409.
rationale: The backend enforces a single submission per student per homework; the student must be told they already submitted.

title: Upload Generic Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display Submission failed. Please try again. on unhandled upload error responses.
rationale: A catch-all error message prevents students from seeing an unhandled blank state on unexpected failures.

title: Latest Submission Response Field - format
description: The content frontend module shall display the format string field from the latest submission response.
rationale: The format field identifies whether the submitted file is latex, markdown, or asciidoc.

title: Latest Submission Response Field - file_size_bytes
description: The content frontend module shall display the file_size_bytes integer from the latest submission response.
rationale: Showing the file size confirms the student's file was stored as expected.

title: Latest Submission Response Field - submitted_at
description: The content frontend module shall display the submitted_at RFC 3339 timestamp from the latest submission response.
rationale: The submission timestamp confirms the recorded time in case a student disputes lateness.

title: Latest Submission Response Field - grading_status
description: The content frontend module shall display the grading_status string from the latest submission response.
rationale: The grading_status tells the student whether their submission is pending, graded, or failed.

title: Course Grade Response Field - weighted_score
description: The content frontend module shall read the weighted_score numeric field from the course grade JSON response.
rationale: weighted_score is the primary value from which the percentage and letter grade are derived.

title: Course Grade Response Field - total_weight
description: The content frontend module shall read the total_weight numeric field from the course grade JSON response.
rationale: total_weight is needed to inform the student how many assignments contributed to the grade.

title: Letter Grade Threshold - A
description: The content frontend module shall display the letter A when weighted_score is greater than or equal to 90.
rationale: 90 is the standard lower bound for an A on the 0-to-100 scale used in the grade module.

title: Letter Grade Threshold - B
description: The content frontend module shall display the letter B when weighted_score is between 80 inclusive and 90 exclusive.
rationale: 80-89 maps to B on the standard academic scale.

title: Letter Grade Threshold - C
description: The content frontend module shall display the letter C when weighted_score is between 70 inclusive and 80 exclusive.
rationale: 70-79 maps to C on the standard academic scale.

title: Letter Grade Threshold - D
description: The content frontend module shall display the letter D when weighted_score is between 60 inclusive and 70 exclusive.
rationale: 60-69 maps to D on the standard academic scale.

title: Letter Grade Threshold - F
description: The content frontend module shall display the letter F when weighted_score is less than 60.
rationale: Below 60 maps to F on the standard academic scale indicating a failing grade.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - raw_score
description: The content frontend module shall display the raw_score numeric field from the per-homework grade response.
rationale: raw_score shows the score before penalties so the student can see the AI professor's unmodified assessment.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - late_penalty_amount
description: The content frontend module shall display the late_penalty_amount numeric field from the per-homework grade response.
rationale: Showing the penalty amount lets the student see exactly how many points were deducted for lateness.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - final_score
description: The content frontend module shall display the final_score numeric field from the per-homework grade response.
rationale: final_score is the grade that counts toward the weighted average after all adjustments.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - badge_waiver_applied
description: The content frontend module shall display whether badge_waiver_applied is true for each per-homework grade.
rationale: Students must know if their late penalty was waived by a badge so they understand the grade calculation.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - graded_at
description: The content frontend module shall display the graded_at RFC 3339 timestamp from the per-homework grade response.
rationale: The graded_at timestamp tells the student when the AI professor assessed their submission.

title: Per-Homework Grade 404 Empty State
description: The content frontend module shall display Not yet graded when the per-homework grade fetch returns HTTP 404.
rationale: 404 means no grade row exists yet; the student must see a clear not-yet-graded state.

title: Badge Definition Fields - id
description: The content frontend module shall bind the id string field from each badge in the GET /api/v1/badges response.
rationale: The badge id is needed to cross-reference the earned badges list from GET /api/v1/users/me/badges.

title: Badge Definition Fields - name
description: The content frontend module shall display the name string field from each badge definition.
rationale: The badge name is the primary identifier the student sees in the badge catalogue.

title: Badge Definition Fields - description
description: The content frontend module shall display the description string field from each badge definition.
rationale: The description explains what the badge represents in student-readable language.

title: Badge Definition Fields - milestone
description: The content frontend module shall display the milestone string field from each badge definition.
rationale: The milestone names the specific achievement that triggers the badge award.

title: Badge Definition Fields - reward
description: The content frontend module shall display the reward string field from each badge definition.
rationale: The reward type tells the student what benefit they receive upon earning the badge.

title: Badge Definition Fields - reward_value
description: The content frontend module shall display the reward_value numeric field from each badge definition.
rationale: The reward_value quantifies the benefit, such as percentage points of grade improvement.

title: Earned Badge Field - awarded_at
description: The content frontend module shall display the awarded_at ISO 8601 timestamp from each earned badge response.
rationale: The award date confirms when the student achieved the milestone.

title: Earned Badge Field - redeemed_for_submission_id
description: The content frontend module shall indicate redeemed when redeemed_for_submission_id is non-null in the earned badge response.
rationale: Students must know whether a badge's reward has already been consumed to avoid expecting a second benefit.

title: Earned Badge Cross-Reference by badge_id
description: The content frontend module shall match earned badges to definitions using the badge_id field from GET /api/v1/users/me/badges.
rationale: Cross-referencing by badge_id links earned records to their definition without a separate per-badge request.

title: Unearned Badge Milestone Display
description: The content frontend module shall display the milestone field as the unlock requirement for each unearned badge.
rationale: Showing the milestone requirement tells students exactly what action will unlock the badge.

title: Notification Poll Interval
description: The content frontend module shall poll GET /api/v1/notifications?unread=true&limit=10 at a 30000 millisecond interval.
rationale: A fixed 30-second interval balances notification freshness with API load.

title: Notification Poll Cleanup on Unmount
description: The content frontend module shall cancel the polling interval when the notification component unmounts.
rationale: Leaving an active interval after unmount causes memory leaks and spurious API calls.

title: Unread Count Derived from notifications Array
description: The content frontend module shall derive the unread count from notifications where read_at is absent or null.
rationale: The backend omits the read_at key entirely for unread notifications; counting entries where read_at is absent or null gives the correct unread total.

title: Notification Type Display
description: The content frontend module shall display the type field value for each notification in the dropdown.
rationale: The type identifies the notification category: api_failure, generation_timeout, or admin_escalation.

title: Notification Message Display
description: The content frontend module shall display the message field for each notification in the dropdown.
rationale: The message carries the human-readable description of what occurred.

title: Notification Timestamp Display
description: The content frontend module shall display the created_at timestamp for each notification in the dropdown.
rationale: The timestamp tells the student when the event occurred, which is important for time-sensitive failures.

title: Mark-Read Request After Poll Update
description: The content frontend module shall update the local notification list to reflect read_at after a successful POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read.
rationale: The local state must match the server so the unread count decrements immediately without waiting for the next poll.

title: Mark All Read Issues Request per Unread Notification
description: The content frontend module shall issue one POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read per notification whose read_at is null.
rationale: The backend does not provide a bulk mark-read endpoint; each notification must be individually marked.

title: Notification 404 Mark-Read Handling
description: The content frontend module shall silently ignore HTTP 404 responses from POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read.
rationale: A 404 means the notification no longer exists; ignoring it prevents a noisy error for a benign race condition.

title: Export PDF URL Construction
description: The content frontend module shall fetch /api/v1/courses/{id}/content/{sectionIndex}/export?format=pdf with a Bearer token.
rationale: The backend exportSection handler requires an authenticated request; the URL must include the format=pdf query parameter.

title: Export HTML URL Construction
description: The content frontend module shall fetch /api/v1/courses/{id}/content/{sectionIndex}/export?format=html with a Bearer token.
rationale: The backend exportSection handler requires an authenticated request; the URL must include the format=html query parameter.

title: Export Download via Fetch Blob
description: The content frontend module shall convert the authenticated export response to a Blob and trigger a programmatic browser download.
rationale: Converting the fetch response to a Blob and using a programmatic click on a temporary object URL delivers the file without requiring anchor navigation that would lose the Authorization header.

title: Feedback JSON Body Field Name
description: The content frontend module shall serialize the feedback textarea value under the JSON key feedback_text in the POST request body.
rationale: The backend decodes the field feedback_text; using any other key returns HTTP 400 BAD_REQUEST.

title: Feedback Request Content-Type Header
description: The content frontend module shall set Content-Type: application/json on the POST feedback request.
rationale: The backend decoder expects JSON; without the correct content type the body will not parse correctly.

title: Feedback HTTP 201 Success Response Handling
description: The content frontend module shall treat HTTP 201 as the success status for the feedback POST request.
rationale: The backend returns 201 Created on success, not 200; treating 200 as success would silently drop the confirmation.

title: Feedback Modal Textarea Character Counter
description: The content frontend module shall display the current character count and the 2000-character limit in the feedback modal.
rationale: A visible counter tells students how much of the limit they have used before hitting the maximum.

title: Previous Section Button Decrements Index
description: The content frontend module shall fetch sectionIndex minus one when the previous section button is clicked.
rationale: The previous button must load the immediately preceding section in the course sequence.

title: Next Section Button Increments Index
description: The content frontend module shall fetch sectionIndex plus one when the next section button is clicked.
rationale: The next button must load the immediately following section in the course sequence.

title: Previous Button Disabled at Index Zero
description: The content frontend module shall set the previous button to a disabled state when section_index equals zero.
rationale: Section index zero is the first section; navigating to index minus one would request an invalid section.

title: Notification Bell Hidden When Unread Count Is Zero
description: The content frontend module shall hide the unread count badge element when the unread count is zero.
rationale: A zero badge is noise; hiding it keeps the nav clean and the badge meaningful when it appears.

title: Upload Progress Uses XHR ProgressEvent
description: The content frontend module shall report upload progress using the XMLHttpRequest upload progress event.
rationale: The fetch API does not expose upload progress; XHR is required to get byte-level progress events.

title: Course Grade No-Submissions Empty State
description: The content frontend module shall display No grades yet. when weighted_score and total_weight are both zero.
rationale: A zero weighted_score with zero total_weight means no graded homework exists yet in the course.

title: Badge Name from Earned Badge Response
description: The content frontend module shall display the badge_name field from each earned badge in GET /api/v1/users/me/badges.
rationale: The earned badge response includes badge_name directly, avoiding a separate lookup in the badge definitions list.

title: Badge Reward from Earned Badge Response
description: The content frontend module shall display the badge_reward and badge_reward_value fields from each earned badge response.
rationale: The earned badge response includes reward details directly, confirming what reward the student received.

title: Notification 403 Mark-Read Handling
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message when POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read returns HTTP 403.
rationale: 403 indicates the student tried to mark another student's notification as read, which must not silently succeed.

title: Export 202 Pending State Message
description: The content frontend module shall display a pending review error when an export request returns HTTP 202.
rationale: The backend returns 202 when the section exists but citation review is not complete; exports are unavailable until review passes.

title: Export 404 Error Message
description: The content frontend module shall display Section not found. when an export request returns HTTP 404.
rationale: The export endpoint returns 404 when GetSectionContent returns ErrNotFound; the user must be informed.

title: Submission View Latest Fetch on 201
description: The content frontend module shall populate latest submission display from the HTTP 201 upload response body.
rationale: The upload response body contains the new submission record; a redundant GET wastes a round-trip.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - late_days
description: The content frontend module shall display the late_days integer field from the per-homework grade response.
rationale: Displaying the number of late days shows the student exactly how their lateness was measured.

title: Per-Homework Grade Field - badge_improvement
description: The content frontend module shall display the badge_improvement numeric field from the per-homework grade response.
rationale: badge_improvement shows any score boost applied by a grade_improvement badge at the course level.

title: Notifications Response Envelope Parsing
description: The content frontend module shall parse the notifications array from the notifications key in the poll response body.
rationale: The backend wraps the list in {"notifications": [...]}; accessing the root directly returns an object, not an array.

title: Feedback Modal Close Button
description: The content frontend module shall provide a cancel button in the feedback modal that closes it without submitting.
rationale: Students must be able to dismiss the feedback modal if they opened it by mistake.

title: Section Fetch Error on Network Failure
description: The content frontend module shall display an error message when the section fetch throws a network error.
rationale: Network failures must surface as errors rather than leaving the loading indicator spinning indefinitely.

title: Feedback Success Displays Confirmation Message
description: The content frontend module shall display Feedback submitted. after the feedback modal closes on HTTP 201.
rationale: An explicit confirmation message tells the student their feedback was received and regeneration is pending.

title: Disable Next Button at Last Section
description: The content frontend module shall disable the next button when section_index equals the last section index.
rationale: Navigating past the last section would request a non-existent index; disabling prevents that invalid request.

title: Notification Dropdown Closes on Overlay Click
description: The content frontend module shall close the notification dropdown when the user clicks outside it.
rationale: Students who open the notification dropdown must be able to dismiss it by clicking anywhere outside, a standard UX expectation for dropdown panels.

title: Notification Fetch Silences 401 Errors
description: The content frontend module shall suppress notification fetch errors when the response status is 401.
rationale: A 401 during polling means the session expired; surfacing it as an error notification would create noise while the user is being redirected to login.

title: Notification Fetch Non-401 Error Display
description: The content frontend module shall display Failed to fetch notifications. when a poll request returns a non-401 error.
rationale: Non-401 errors indicate a real service problem that the student should be aware of so they can report or retry.

title: Mark-All-Read Button Visible Only When Unread Exist
description: The content frontend module shall render the mark-all-read button only when unread notification count is greater than zero.
rationale: Showing a mark-all-read button when nothing is unread would be confusing and trigger pointless API calls.

title: Mark-All-Read Issues Parallel Requests
description: The content frontend module shall mark all unread notifications as read concurrently.
rationale: Sequential requests multiply latency proportionally to unread count; concurrent requests complete in a single round-trip regardless of count.

title: Notification Polling Interval Cancelled on Unmount
description: The content frontend module shall cancel the notification polling interval when the panel component unmounts.
rationale: An uncancelled interval continues firing after the component is destroyed, leaking memory and issuing API calls against a non-existent component.
